hooks.command: git rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; n=$(git rev-list --count origin/main..HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo 0); [ "$n" -gt 0 ] 2>/dev/null || exit 0; br=$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>/dev/null); list=$(git log --oneline -20 origin/main..HEAD 2>/dev/null); msg=$(printf "\xe2\x9a\xa0 Unmerged work: branch %s has %s commit(s) NOT on origin/main:\n%s\n-> merge or open a PR to main before ending, or it stays stranded." "$br" "$n" "$list"); node -e "process.stdout.write(JSON.stringify({systemMessage:process.argv[1]}))" "$msg"
